title: When the Harvest Turns
author: Vesper Almeida
blurb: Dominic Ishikawa, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
